purpose: Each criterion of US-20502 driven through bin/rcf.js as a child process over a fixture project made by its own rcf init and committed to git (or a fixture git repository for the audit), with well-formed verdict and TestStrengthReport records keyed to their heads; AC-20502-5 is bound to the existing audit tests that pin each exit code (regression guards).
title: Test strength a report: finalise, verdict test and the separation audit through bin/rcf.js, and the audit's own exit codes

testCases.description: with a test-strength record at H covering both touched criteria and a non-pass result, finalise writes complete and exits 0, printing one "test-strength at <H7>: <AC id> <fail|blocked>: <reason>; recorded, not refused" line per such criterion
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/strength-report-0-41-0.test.js::AC-20502-1: with a test-strength record at H covering both touched criteria and a non-pass result, finalise writes complete and exits 0, printing one "test-strength at <H7>: <AC id> <fail|blocked>: <reason>; recorded, not refused" line per such criterion

testCases.description: finalise still refuses with exit 4 "finalise refused: no test-strength record at <H7>" with no record at H, and "finalise refused: test-strength at <H7> omits <ids>" when the record omits a touched criterion, a failing criterion in the same record notwithstanding
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/strength-report-0-41-0.test.js::AC-20502-2: finalise still refuses with exit 4 "finalise refused: no test-strength record at <H7>" with no record at H, and "finalise refused: test-strength at <H7> omits <ids>" when the record omits a touched criterion, a failing criterion in the same record notwithstanding

testCases.description: rcf build verdict test --fbs FBS-001 --result PASS --tap <file> --runtime <text> records PASS and exits 0 when the test-strength record at H has result fail
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/strength-report-0-41-0.test.js::AC-20502-3: rcf build verdict test --fbs FBS-001 --result PASS --tap <file> --runtime <text> records PASS and exits 0 when the test-strength record at H has result fail

testCases.description: rcf audit separation passes a range where a TEST: commit adds a failing test-strength record and a FINALISE: commit follows, and a DEFINE: after BUILD: with no failed REVIEW or TEST verdict still fails
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/strength-report-0-41-0.test.js::AC-20502-4: rcf audit separation passes a range where a TEST: commit adds a failing test-strength record and a FINALISE: commit follows, and a DEFINE: after BUILD: with no failed REVIEW or TEST verdict still fails

testCases.description: regression guard for AC-20502-5 (exit 0, every criterion passes): AC-19901-1: over a bin entry, a harness glob and AC-101-1 bound to a test importing only node:test, node:assert and test/_harness/run.js, with a symbol-level Code Node whose mutants all fail it, rcf audit test-strength --acs AC-101-1 exits 0 with the PASS line
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/audit-test-strength.test.js::AC-19901-1: over a bin entry, a harness glob and AC-101-1 bound to a test importing only node:test, node:assert and test/_harness/run.js, with a symbol-level Code Node whose mutants all fail it, rcf audit test-strength --acs AC-101-1 exits 0 with the PASS line

testCases.description: regression guard for AC-20502-5 (exit 4, a criterion fails): AC-19901-2: a bound test also importing src/store.js exits 4 with "test-strength: FAIL 1 of 1 criteria at <h7>: AC-101-1 imports src/store.js (not the app entry or the harness)"

testCases.description: regression guard for AC-20502-5 (exit 5, one criterion blocked and none failing): AC-19901-9: a bound test file test/rcf/a.test.py, or a symbol-level Code Node on src/x.py, makes AC-101-1 BLOCKED (result "blocked", reason "TEST_STRENGTH_UNSUPPORTED", detail naming the file) while AC-101-2 is still judged, exit 5; a malformed runners entry exits 2; .js, .mjs and .cjs files are read

testCases.description: regression guard for AC-20502-5 (exit 2, a red unmutated run): AC-19902-9: a declared runner that fails on every bound test makes rcf audit test-strength --acs AC-101-1 exit 2 naming the runner and the bound test, with no mutant run and neither the PASS line nor a FAIL line

testCases.description: AC-20502-6: finalise accepts the test-strength record at H only when it is a valid TestStrengthReport v1 whose embedded head is H and which covers the touched criteria; a record for another head exits 4 "finalise refused: test-strength record at <H7> is for <X7>, not the reviewed head", an invalid record exits 4 "finalise refused: test-strength record at <H7> is not a valid TestStrengthReport v1", a missing one exits 4 "finalise refused: no test-strength record at <H7>", each leaving the spec and working tree unchanged
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/strength-report-0-41-0.test.js::AC-20502-6: finalise accepts the test-strength record at H only when it is a valid TestStrengthReport v1 whose embedded head is H and which covers the touched criteria; a record for another head exits 4 "finalise refused: test-strength record at <H7> is for <X7>, not the reviewed head", an invalid record exits 4 "finalise refused: test-strength record at <H7> is not a valid TestStrengthReport v1", a missing one exits 4 "finalise refused: no test-strength record at <H7>", each leaving the spec and working tree unchanged
